unstuck_said.text: Filed a checked upstream settlement feature request on the official Vapi MCP server repo (VapiAI/mcp-server#28, OPEN, github.com/VapiAI/mcp-server/issues/28): accept Nano (XNO) for voice-assistant spend beside card/credits, so a self-custody XNO-only agent can drive Vapi voice assistants via the MCP without onboarding a card. Framed as an add-not-switch in Vapi's own per-minute metered agent-native settlement terms.
